column1: # XML fact counters (any XML, XSD, XSLT, Spring, Maven): one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex),
# counted over the whole file. The [ignore] line runs first and reads the file as a parser does,
# leftmost region first: it blanks comments, CDATA sections and processing instructions (keeping the
# line breaks), so a commented-out element does not count and a "<!--" inside CDATA opens nothing.
# Element and attribute counts are regex heuristics over the text, not a parse: a ">" inside an
# attribute value or markup inside a DOCTYPE entity is not seen. XmlFactPatternsTest pins every case;
